title: Complete Consolidated Border and In-Content Chips in LaTeX Templates
description: The semio design system was changed to consolidated border with in-content chips from the out-content chips with separate elements. The latex templates are not correctly reflecting this. Complete the design system also on latex.
summary: LaTeX packages now follow the shared-border splitting logic: neighbouring frames (headings, windows, tables, registers, lists, row tiles) share one hairline, the text column is a closed frame between the navbar and footer rules with inset prose, heading chips are in-content with no rule below the chip row, and lists are split into one bordered cell per point. Verified on junction fixtures (edges coincide within 0.01 pt), report, thesis, flyer and the energy assignment; paper, phd and Zukunft Bau produce no PDF in the local harness (also with unmodified packages for paper) and were not checked. See summary.md.
